description: Use when standard Salesforce indexes are insufficient for query performance on high-volume objects: requesting custom indexes via Salesforce Support for standard fields, deploying custom field indexes via Metadata API, requesting skinny tables, or designing two-column composite indexes. NOT for SOQL query optimization techniques (use data/soql-query-optimization) or general large data volume design (use architect skills).
inputs: Object name and approximate record count
The SOQL query (or queries) that is performing poorly
Query plan output from the Query Plan tool in Developer Console
Field(s) used in WHERE and ORDER BY clauses of the slow query
name: custom-index-requests
official_sources: Best Practices for Deployments with Large Data Volumes (`salesforce_large_data_volumes_bp.txt`): custom indexes via Support or a custom index XML file via Metadata API (L395); copied to all sandboxes (L398); default indexed fields and unindexable types (L399-409); External IDs create an index, allowed types, Support for others (L418-424); null rows excluded and rebuild needed (L436-438); thresholds and worked examples (L463-471); non-deterministic formula cases (L485-505); two-column indexes, column roles, nulls in the second column (L524-538); skinny tables: join avoidance, objects, warning, 200 columns, no cross-object fields, Full sandboxes only (L329-385); nightly statistics (L315-319); NA placeholder for null filters on picklists and foreign keys (L960).

Apex Developer Guide (`salesforce_apex_developer_guide.txt`): fields indexed by default including External ID or Unique custom fields; unindexable types; TEXT() on picklists; when a custom index isn't used (L9641-9663); upsert key matched multiple times returns an error (L7868).

Metadata API Developer Guide (`api_meta.txt`): CustomIndex type, `.indx-meta`, API 50.0+, special access rule to contact Customer Support, `allowNullValues`, `booleanIndexedValue` (L41099-41138); CustomField `externalId` and `unique` as separate booleans, `caseSensitive` (L43328, L43402-43404, L43702).

REST API Developer Guide (`api_rest.txt`): external ID matched multiple times returns a 300 error on upsert (L2977); `explain` plan fields and `relativeCost` above 1.0 meaning not selective (L17784-17867).
Bulk API 2.0 Developer Guide (`api_asynch.txt`): the same 300 error for duplicated external IDs in ingest (L2500).
Salesforce Help 000386864: Developer Console Query Plan Tool FAQ — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000386864&language=en_US&type=1
Salesforce Help 000383981: Make a SOQL query selective by marking a field as External ID or Unique — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000383981&language=en_US&type=1
Query and Search Optimization (SOQL and SOSL Reference) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.soql_sosl.meta/soql_sosl/sforce_api_calls_soql_select_optimization.htm
outputs: Recommendation: custom index, skinny table, or two-column index
Salesforce Support case template for requesting index or skinny table
Selectivity validation: confirm the field meets index selectivity thresholds
